records.review-93cm-2v4m-c56c-1105.title: Arc: DuckDB aliases and tenant boundaries
records.review-93cm-2v4m-c56c-1105.body: The advisory reports cross-database reads by authenticated tokens through DuckDB I/O aliases within the shared storage root. Its prose describes an unresolved issue including 26.06.2, while the structured API names a fix-equivalent commit version; these claims conflict.
records.review-93cm-2v4m-c56c-1105.actio: Do not infer resolution from the API fix field alone. Verify file access boundaries per database and restrict access to the shared root.
records.review-mc8m-rr6c-r5qr-1105.title: Payload: client uploads and collection permissions
records.review-mc8m-rr6c-r5qr-1105.body: Affected configurations enable client uploads in @payloadcms/storage-vercel-blob and let authenticated users access the upload route. Configurations without client uploads are outside this path.
records.review-mc8m-rr6c-r5qr-1105.actio: Upgrade to 3.90.0 or 4.0.0-canary.34 or later. Until then disable client uploads or enforce collection permissions on the route.
records.review-3cgg-c5pp-57h6-1105.title: odf-kit: XSS through style attributes in converted documents
records.review-3cgg-c5pp-57h6-1105.body: odtToHtml() and odsToHtml() interpolate unescaped style values. Inserting the output from a crafted document as HTML can execute script. Versions from 0.6.0 up to but excluding 0.14.2 are affected.
records.review-3cgg-c5pp-57h6-1105.actio: Upgrade to 0.14.2 or later and avoid directly displaying HTML from untrusted documents. Review previously converted output too.
records.review-gh9r-c94j-cmp5-1105.title: Stanza: nested pickle escapes weights_only checks
records.review-gh9r-c94j-cmp5-1105.body: The lemmatizer in 1.14.0 performs unrestricted deserialization of compressed pickle inside a model. The advisory reports code execution as the loading user from an attacker-supplied lemma .pt. torch.load with weights_only=True does not inspect that inner pickle.
records.review-gh9r-c94j-cmp5-1105.actio: Upgrade to 1.15.0 and reject models of unknown origin. Investigate execution history and credential exposure in environments that already loaded them.
records.review-33r5-xmm8-v6x5-1105.title: Elo: constructor access in JavaScript output
records.review-33r5-xmm8-v6x5-1105.body: An attacker-controlled Elo string can reach host code execution when generated JavaScript is executed through unfiltered constructor access. This differs from the separate advisory about directly supplied AST objects.
records.review-33r5-xmm8-v6x5-1105.actio: Upgrade @enspirit/elo to 1.0.1. Do not execute code generated from untrusted input in a process with secrets or host privileges.
records.review-7w38-ggh5-v542-1105.title: Elo: interpolation in generated Ruby
records.review-7w38-ggh5-v542-1105.body: The Ruby backend does not sufficiently escape interpolation in emitted string literals and subtype-constraint labels. Running Ruby generated from crafted Elo can evaluate attacker-controlled expressions.
records.review-7w38-ggh5-v542-1105.actio: Upgrade @enspirit/elo to 1.0.1 and regenerate Ruby output. Safety of output from another backend does not establish safety of the Ruby output.
records.review-x9rp-7wh3-2rj5-1105.title: Elo: validation of programmatic AST input
records.review-x9rp-7wh3-2rj5-1105.body: Integrations that construct AST objects from JSON or plugins can pass unchecked fields into JavaScript, Ruby, Python or SQL output, enabling code injection. This input boundary differs from the normal string parser.
records.review-x9rp-7wh3-2rj5-1105.actio: Upgrade @enspirit/elo to 1.0.1. Validate AST types and syntax and isolate generation and execution from untrusted ASTs.
records.review-p3jp-9v83-76w9-1105.title: .NET Brotli: new indexing and existing remediation
records.review-p3jp-9v83-76w9-1105.body: This is a GHSA registration for the previously covered CVE-2026-111497. Exposure requires processing attacker-controlled Brotli data with decompression enabled; ASP.NET Core and HttpClient do not enable this automatically by default. .NET Framework is unaffected.
records.review-p3jp-9v83-76w9-1105.actio: Apply the fixed version for each branch and package in the table, including 8.0.33, 9.0.22 and 10.0.14. Republish NativeAOT with the updated toolchain and verify distributed artifacts.
records.review-48v2-6jcm-fc99-1105.title: praktor: Telegram uploads cross workspace boundaries
records.review-48v2-6jcm-fc99-1105.body: In 0.9.0 and earlier, a Telegram document filename can write outside uploads within the persistent agent workspace. Overwritten instruction or configuration files can affect subsequent runs. This is not proof of arbitrary writes across the host.
records.review-48v2-6jcm-fc99-1105.actio: Upgrade to 0.9.1 and restrict allowed Telegram user IDs. Review instructions, skills, hooks and upload history in existing volumes.
records.review-j97h-3f8r-mrjr-1105.title: Keycloak: signature verification bypass in JWT Authorization Grant
records.review-j97h-3f8r-mrjr-1105.body: An attacker with valid client credentials can exploit algorithm confusion in the JWT Authorization Grant flow to bypass signature verification and issue tokens for federated users linked to the affected Identity Provider. This does not establish an attack without credentials against every user.
records.review-j97h-3f8r-mrjr-1105.actio: Upgrade keycloak-services to 26.6.4. Review the affected flow, Identity Provider and client credentials and investigate unauthorized token issuance.
records.review-9ppr-wfw9-xvr2-1105.title: Netfoil: stale records from missing TTL decrement
records.review-9ppr-wfw9-xvr2-1105.body: The advisory states that versions from 0.3.0 up to but excluding 0.6.1 do not decrement TTL and continue serving stale records. Its brief description does not establish a compromise or data leak.
records.review-9ppr-wfw9-xvr2-1105.actio: Upgrade to 0.6.1 and review cache and record expiry.
records.review-h26j-4vp7-x9w2-1105.title: Metalama: code execution through same-user named pipes
records.review-h26j-4vp7-x9w2-1105.body: Unrestricted deserialization over Visual Studio inter-process pipes can execute code. Writing requires code execution as the same Windows user already; this does not establish privilege escalation. The prose says no backports, while the API also lists 2025.1.18 and 2026.0.25 as fixes; the conflict is retained.
records.review-h26j-4vp7-x9w2-1105.actio: Check Metalama 2026.1.19 and the maintained PostSharp extension 2026.1.5. Remove or migrate retired extensions and cross-check advisory and shipped releases for older branches.
records.review-m3qr-fvp4-78xj-1105.title: Arc: logs route registered before authentication middleware
records.review-m3qr-fvp4-78xj-1105.body: The advisory reports unauthenticated access to recent application logs because /api/v1/logs is registered before authentication middleware even with authentication enabled. Internal paths and database names may leak; retrieval of the bootstrap admin token was not confirmed.
records.review-m3qr-fvp4-78xj-1105.actio: Place the logs route behind authentication and administrator authorization or block it if unused. Verify artifacts contain the fix commit in the table and review sensitive data in stored logs.
records.npm-malware-1105.title: npm: 194 malicious-package advisories
records.npm-malware-1105.body: The publication window contains 194 malware advisories for npm. The table preserves package names, affected ranges and absent fixes from the original API. Advisory counts are not compromised device or victim counts.
records.npm-malware-1105.action: Check installation, startup and CI history against lockfiles. Isolate affected environments and revoke and reissue secrets from a clean environment. Investigate logs and rebuild rather than treating deletion alone as resolution.

records.kev-additions-1105.title: KEV: 2 additions for WordPress and Apple
records.kev-additions-1105.body: WordPress CVE-2026-119977, added 11/3, concerns unauthenticated code execution during core upgrades. Apple CVE-2024-27834, added 11/4, concerns pointer authentication bypass with existing arbitrary read/write capability. KEV additions do not mean 2 newly occurring incidents.
records.kev-additions-1105.action: Prioritize the WordPress upgrade window and exposed staging paths and follow vendor mitigations. Check official updates for affected Apple operating systems. KEV dueDate is 11/6 for WordPress and 11/18 for Apple; these are not universal legal deadlines.
